scope: Two independent browser contexts, production HTML/JS, HTTP handler, real local Postgres; not cloud deployment.
checks: A second independent reader reads and replies to the first reader; language switching preserves draft.
User HTML is displayed as text and never runs.
Refreshing preserves an unfinished reply and saved messages survive a full page reload.
A saved request with a lost HTTP response can be retried without duplicate messages.
The existing map and 132-node/157-edge network still initialise.
An unconfigured release hides the feature and makes no discussion API calls; anchored titles clear the sticky header.
Desktop and mobile layouts have no horizontal overflow or JavaScript errors.
